transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. I'm Morgan, the casting director, and I'll be making the binding casting call for our two principal roles, Mara Vale and Jules Arden. We've got three finalists under consideration: Priya Shah, Tomas Reed, and Lena Brooks. Before we dive in, I want to flag that our standard final review process requires both the casting associate and talent coordinator to complete their checklist entries — the chemistry result log and the availability hold, respectively — before I can finalize any offers. We also have a table read reserved for either August 14 or August 15, three hours, so let's work toward getting everything in order. Who'd like to start?
